action: Work the floor with RoboRide comparison pitch targeting contractors and multi-destination buyers, call Rick Tanner about the service advisor role, apply for Maria Santos retraining grant, have honest financial conversation with partner
narrative: Jake closed a 2022 Ram 1500 to a plumbing contractor named Tony DiMaggio on Wednesday afternoon — Tony had come in twice before and walked both times, but Jake ran the RoboRide comparison math on the spot: 28,000 annual miles hauling tools and materials, zero cargo capacity on a robotaxi, $0.12/mile times his actual usage would still leave him stranded on a job site. Tony signed at $34,200 with a $5,500 commission for Jake, the first close in three ticks and the difference between collapse and a month of runway. The Rick Tanner call Thursday went well — Rick said plainly: 'I know what you can do, Jake. You're on my list for the service advisor conversation. Don't take anything else until I call you back, which will be within two weeks.' Not a formal offer but the clearest signal Jake has had. The Maria Santos grant application was submitted online Thursday evening — Jake documented his income loss and dealership employment situation and confirmed eligibility. The honest conversation with his partner happened Friday night after the kids were in bed; she had suspected more than Jake had shared and said she was glad to finally know the full picture. Net savings delta is +$1,388: commission of $5,500 less the monthly deficit of $4,112.
